statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail risk 20% sits at the bottom of the watch band while stress eases to 67% after a softer August inflation print.
recommendation: Tail remains well below the block threshold, so the mapped policy state is WATCH. The narrow evidence-based danger window runs 13:30Z to 15:30Z, covering the quarter-end US cash open, Chicago PMI and the first full cash hour where a delayed second leg would appear. A second, smaller watch-band window is projected at 20:00Z to 22:00Z around the quarter-end close and Micron's post-close report. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected.
headline: August core PCE undershoots at 3.0% as NQ lifts 0.41% and yields ease into a quarter-end cash open
body: The August personal income and outlays report released at 12:30Z resolved the session's main uncertainty to the soft side. Core PCE rose 0.2% on the month and 3.0% year over year against consensus of 0.3% and 3.3%, with July revised down to 3.0% from 3.3%; headline PCE rose 0.3% monthly and 3.4% year over year. Nasdaq-100 futures trade 30,739.25, up 0.41%, inside a day range of 30,512.25 to 30,779.50, which leaves price roughly 40 points below the session high rather than pinned at the extreme. The cross-asset reaction is coherent and orderly rather than pathological: the 10-year Treasury yield eased about 4 basis points to roughly 5.22%, the 2-year to roughly 4.87% and the 30-year about 4 basis points to roughly 5.55% after touching its highest level since 2002 in the prior session, while VIX fell 1.50% to 15.80 within a 15.62 to 16.32 range. That combination of a benign surprise, easing long-end yields, decaying implied volatility and an observed retracement off the high is the orderly price discovery that keeps Tail at the bottom of the watch band. The reason Tail does not fall further is timing rather than structure: the US cash open at 13:30Z had only just occurred at the assessment cutoff and Chicago PMI at 13:45Z is still ahead, so post-open structure on the final session of the quarter is unobserved, and quarter-end rebalancing can distort the opening auction. An aligned bullish regime meeting a quarter-end open is the configuration where opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would become meaningful Tail evidence, and that evidence does not yet exist. Stress stays high at 67% because the rates complex remains the dominant carrier, with the long end near multi-decade highs even after today's easing, and because crude conflicts with the disinflation read: WTI is up 2.10% at $91.25 and Brent up 2.60% at $98.67 on continued US-Iran uncertainty. The Fed raised its target range to 3.75-4.00% on 16 September, and the softer print reduces the pressure for an October follow-up. Ahead lie Micron's fiscal Q4 results after the US close, whose exact release time is not verified and which is therefore carried as a driver rather than a dated event, and the 1 October jobless claims and ISM Manufacturing block. Shared Finviz context was collected at 2026-09-29T23:14Z with partial status and no futures coverage, so it is stale under the 90-minute freshness rule and was not used as current evidence.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 hours Claude Tail risk eased from 20% through a 24% peak at 2026-09-29T15:00Z down to 15% overnight, then firmed back to 20% at 12:00Z as the August inflation block approached. Stress fell steadily from 74% to 65% before rising to 70%, and the yellow WATCH readings of the 29 September US session gave way to a green EA_ON run from 20:00Z through 11:00Z. One hour, 2026-09-29T14:00Z, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable. Dominant mode moved from trend-down during the 29 September cash session to normal overnight and then mixed, consistent with orderly two-way trade rather than sustained one-way structure.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds Tail in the 20% watch band through 14:00Z, covering the quarter-end cash open, Chicago PMI and the first full cash hour where a delayed second leg from the 12:30Z data would appear, then eases to EA_ON from 15:00Z on the base case of orderly price discovery and continued volatility decay. A second watch-band window at 20:00Z to 21:00Z reflects the quarter-end cash close and Micron's fiscal Q4 report landing in a thin post-close book, where a semiconductor repricing is the plausible delayed second-leg mechanism. Overnight and through the European session Tail settles at 17-18% while confidence decays from 87% to 66% as the verified evidence base ages, before a final watch-band slot at 12:00Z on 1 October ahead of jobless claims and ISM Manufacturing.
